ARM64: configs: j4lte: Disable Samsung securities

When it comes to custom kernel or ROM, these will prevent
the users from using custom binaries.

Disable them for peace of mind. These are:

  - Realtime Kernel Protection (RKP)
  - File-based Integrity Verifier (FIVE)
  - TIMA
  - KNOX Kernel Active Protection (KAP)
  - KNOX Network Context Module (NCM)
  - Samsung Rooting Protection
  - SDP (and DLP)
  - etc.

Signed-off-by: Hendra Manudinata <manoedinata@gmail.com>

init: Don't force `TIMA_LKMAUTH` to be enabled

Previously, `TIMA_LKMAUTH` will be enabled if `MODULES` is.
And it can't be disabled unless module support is disabled as well.

We don't need TIMA-related things, including "authenticating loaded
modules", so remove TIMA_LKMAUTH dependency over module support.

scripts: fips_fmp_utils: Add more function definition and inclusion

During build, these warnings are seen:

  ../scripts/fips_fmp_utils.c: In function ‘main’:
  ../scripts/fips_fmp_utils.c:24:7: warning: implicit declaration of
  function ‘strcmp’ [-Wimplicit-function-declaration]
     24 |  if (!strcmp("-u", argv[1])) {
        |       ^~~~~~

  ../scripts/fips_fmp_utils.c:46:10: warning: implicit declaration of
  function ‘update_fmp_hmac’ [-Wimplicit-function-declaration]
     46 |   return update_fmp_hmac(vmlinux_file, hmac_file, offset);
        |          ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

  ../scripts/fips_fmp_utils.c:73:10: warning: implicit declaration of
  function ‘collect_fmp_bytes’ [-Wimplicit-function-declaration]
     73 |   return collect_fmp_bytes(in_file, section_name, offset, size, out_file);

This is because the code lacks of some function definition. However,
Samsung have fixed these warnings by adding the required definitions, as

yet) these, so we should add it ourself.

[1] https://github.com/scrappy610/N920TUVU3DPG1_Kernel/blob/fda1cae151b9df9e037d08352ec1678b127ef5d4/scripts/fips_fmp_utils.c#L12-L16

firmware: Convert firmware binary to IHEX

Same reason as before, binary files are not copied to the output
directory, resulting in this error:

  firmware/exynos7570_acpm_pedo.fw.gen.S: Assembler messages:
  firmware/exynos7570_acpm_pedo.fw.gen.S:5: Error: file not found: firmware/exynos7570_acpm_pedo.fw
  make[2]: *** [../scripts/Makefile.build:293: firmware/exynos7570_acpm_pedo.fw.gen.o] Error 1

`firmware/Makefile` has the conversion rule already, so all we need to
do is to convert the firmware binaries to IHEX.

init: Setup IHEX conversion rule

When building with seperated out directory ("O=..."), these errors may
appear:

  ../init/_vmm.S: Assembler messages:
  ../init/_vmm.S:41: Error: file not found: init/vmm.elf
  make[2]: *** [../scripts/Makefile.build:293: init/_vmm.o] Error 1

`init/_vmm.S` requires `init/vmm.elf` binary for Samsung TIMA. However,
binary files are not copied to the output directory, hence the assembler
complaints about unexistent binary file even though it does exist.

One way to solve this is to convert the binary to IHEX format as a
placeholder, then set up a Makefile rule to convert it back to original
format.

Command used to convert `elf64-little` binary to IHEX:

  $ aarch64-linux-android-objcopy \
        -I elf64-little init/vmm.elf \
        -O ihex init/vmm.elf.ihex

Inspired from [1].

[1] https://github.com/jcadduono/android_kernel_samsung_universal8895/commit/51133fc2dce917818cd9fb82f470ad20c308e533

Signed-off-by: Hendra Manudinata <manoedinata@gmail.com>

  ./drivers/media/usb/siano/Kconfig:5:config SMS_USB_DRV

Signed-off-by: Hendra Manudinata <manoedinata@gmail.com>

Makefile: Define and set `PLATFORM_VERSION` to `10`

`PLATFORM_VERSION` is a variable that defines Android version target
we're building the Kernel for. Build system will then define two more
variables: `ANDROID_VERSION` and `ANDROID_PLATFORM_VERSION`.

These variables are used for some Makefile configurations, e.g.
`sdcardfs` driver selection (as seen in `fs/sdcardfs/Makefile`).

Set `PLATFORM_VERSION` to 10 as we're building kernel for Android 10
and/or we're using Android 10 Kernel source.

This fixes these compilation errors:

  Kconfig:15:warning: environment variable ANDROID_MAJOR_VERSION undefined
  fs/sdcardfs//Kconfig:5: recursive inclusion detected. Inclusion path:
    current file : 'fs/sdcardfs//Kconfig'
    included from: 'fs/sdcardfs//Kconfig:7'
  make[1]: *** [scripts/kconfig/Makefile:105: exynos7570-j4lte_defconfig] Error 1

Signed-off-by: Hendra Manudinata <manoedinata@gmail.com>
